data.one_liner: A Masonry grid layout widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a MasonryView widget that arranges items in columns based on available vertical space. It accepts a list of items, a column count, and an itemBuilder callback.
use_when: You need a Pinterest‑style masonry grid
You want a simple, no‑dependency grid layout
avoid_when: You need advanced layout features like sticky headers
You require performance optimizations for very large lists
You need a fully featured grid package with sorting or filtering
strengths: Supports any item type via builder
weaknesses: No support for dynamic column changes at runtime
No built‑in item spacing or padding customization
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: More features, active maintenance, supports dynamic columns and spacing
